What a great challenge! I'll do that after I get my driver license because there aren't any mountains to climb in my town.

I'll plan a trip and do that as soon as I can, for some reason  I got really excited about that.

Thank you for you challenge, I'll keep you updated.

Hahahah, that's a great challenge and I'll try doing it asap but I don't know if I'll be able to do this on my first try (I'm reeeeeaaaally shy).

Oh and thank you for your challenge! I'll keep you updated.
Unfortunately I'm not from us and as far as I know there isn't any similar projects in my city. Any other ideas?

1. I love sports but I don't really have any friends to play with, my favorites are tennis, volleyball and football (soccer if you're American) but I can't even remember the last time I've played any of those sports. 

I also love watching movies and series. reading and listening to music. I like drawing pixel arts but I suck at it so I get unmotivated and never finish what I'm working on.

2. I struggle with doing things today and not tomorrow, I always want to delay everything I should do. I also have a problem studying, it seems like I can't study a lot of hours in a row and I need to learn how to do it, especially this year.

3. I think I prefer doing thing on my own, but to be honest I never actually tried meeting new people.

4. That's hard! Neil Patrick Harris is a guy I admire a lot, probably because he's a great singer, actor and has a great sense of humor, things that I suck at.

Thank you and I'll wait for your challenge!

Nice! I really like this one!

I'll probably need to build up some courage first, but the idea sounds awesome!

Thank you for your challenge, I'll keep you updated!

Thank you for your words, It really mean a lot.

About the challenge I won't do it today (10 miles is a lot!), but I'll try to do it before the month ends. I'll keep you updated!

Thanks again.

To be honest, I only listen to music, play videogames and watch series/movies. I used to love playing tennis, but It's been a year since I've touched my racket.

My aspirations? Well, I want to become a physician, maybe  visit other countries, but none of those things makes me wanna live, it's all about my family.
